section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Location of Switches and Relays
title: PASSENGER AND LUGGAGE COMPARTMENT SWITCHES AND RELAYS

content.description: Exploded view diagram showing the location of various switches, relays, and solenoids in the passenger and luggage compartment of a 1986 Toyota Supra. The diagram shows two main views: an upper view of the passenger compartment dashboard/door area and a lower view of the rear luggage compartment area.
